quoted.text:
Steelers 2026 WR Room Forcast:

D.K. Metcalf - Lock
Michael Pittman Jr - Lock
Germie Bernard - Lock
Kaden Wetjen - 99.99% makes it
Benny Skowronek-98% makes it
Roman Wilson - 70% makes it
Max Hurleman- 30% makes it
Brandon Smith - 2% makes it
Levi Wentz - cut/P-Squad
Joaquin Davis - cut
Jakobie Keeney-James - cut
Cornell Powell - cut
Isiah Winstead - cut

This is an interesting room. There is a huge battle for WR4, WR5 & WR6 if they keep 6.  

Wetjen should be a Lock as a 4th rounder and primary returner.
Skowronek is the do it all ST captain. He is a great blocker as a WR and is Rodgers best friend.  It's hard to cut that guy.
Wilson has improved greatly, seems more confident, but his main problem is consistency.   
Hurleman is a guy who just performs every shot he gets.  He stood out as a rookie last preseason and made the practice squad and he stood out again on Thursday.  Eventually you put a guy like that on your roster or lose him.  
Smith has an outside shot to make the team, but there would need to be injuries. 
The rest are practice squad candidates or cut.  If they are keeping 6 WRs, the question is do you give Roman 1 last shot because of pedigree or do you keep Hurleman who performs every opportunity he gets, albeit against lower competition?
